prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web application direction comp, 16:10 landscape
Primary request: Design Sylph as a remote coding Workspace where every Workspace is a live movement with ownership, destination, current state, and an unbroken handoff trail.
Scene/backdrop: Full-bleed 1600x1000 desktop application, no device frame and no marketing page.
Structure: A compact vertical flight-progress-strip bay occupies the left 22 percent with several parallel Workspaces; the selected strip pulls forward and unfolds into a wide center agent conversation and evidence log; a tall live browser preview owns the right 42 percent. Compact application chrome across the top carries Sylph, repository identity, keyboard search, and user status. A narrow bottom rail shows Files, Changes, Skills, Runs as literal tools, not tabs floating in cards.
Content: Selected Workspace `Checkout restoration`, repository `folkhero-web`, agent session `Polish the onboarding flow`, other strips `Fix OAuth callback`, `Tighten empty state`, `Upgrade billing webhook`; live states `Running`, `Waiting`, `Ready`; browser preview contains a tasteful SaaS onboarding screen; agent says `I found the mobile overflow and am testing the corrected flow.`; show `src/routes/onboarding.tsx`, `Browser checks 4/4`, and `Agent controlling browser`.
Style/medium: Production-grade developer tool inspired by air-traffic flight progress strips and coordination bays. Pressed fiberboard ground, warm paper strips, grease-pencil annotations, tiny status lamps, precisely machined rails. Modern workhorse humanist sans, compact tabular numerals.
Composition/framing: The strip bay makes parallel work legible, but the browser preview is the largest single surface. Active work feels physically advanced. Use one continuous workbench with slots and rails, not rounded cards.
Lighting/mood: Daylit coordination room, quiet concentration, tactile but clean.
Color palette: fiberboard #D8D5C8, graphite #242522, signal orange #E96B3B, deep teal #316B74, paper white #F5F1E8.
Materials/textures: pressed board, paper fibers, graphite rules, restrained enamel lamps.
Text (verbatim where shown): `Sylph`, `Checkout restoration`, `folkhero-web`, `Polish the onboarding flow`, `Fix OAuth callback`, `Tighten empty state`, `Upgrade billing webhook`, `Running`, `Waiting`, `Ready`, `Browser checks 4/4`, `Agent controlling browser`.
Constraints: Must read as an agentic cloud IDE, with code, conversation, skills, browser preview, testing, and parallel Workspaces. Dense, keyboard-friendly, clear focus, accessible contrast. No invented claims.
Avoid: airport illustration, literal airplanes, generic kanban, generic dark IDE, rounded-card dashboard, glassmorphism, neon, excessive pills, device frame, marketing page, tiny illegible labels.
